text:
terry: Heads-up we got a pen-test intake (PT-823). Summary: staging KMS key policy permits a deploy role decrypt, Dedicated hosts missing SSM session transcripts, and API Gateway bodies are redacted. Need triage + remediation plan + retest window.
sam: please drop the S3 report path.
terry: s3://redwood-pt/reports/PT-823/2026-03-20/report.pdf
jess: ok, KMS first. which key alias?
terry: alias/redwood/staging-kms-v1. report shows principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/deploy-service in policy.
sam: if deploy-service can decrypt staging secrets that's an immediate risk. Suggest: create new CMK, assign alias staging-kms-v2, remove the principal from old key policy, and rotate secrets encrypted with the old key. Hot rotate possible with care.
jess: note: tfstate backend might reference the key. We'll need to update backend config and run a migrate plan. I can handle terraform pieces.
pagerduty: I can schedule a page for the maintenance window if you pick a time.
terry: recommended owners: KMS & tfstate -> jess. SSM transcripts -> sam. API body archival -> terry. Proposed window: tonight 02:00-03:30 UTC. Good?
jess: I can take 02:00-03:00 for the key work. Plan: 1) create CMK + alias 2) patch policy to remove deploy-service principal 3) update TF backend + `terraform state mv` where needed 4) re-encrypt with `aws kms re-encrypt`. I'll post runbook commands.
sam: I'll enable session-manager transcripts to S3 and validate with a dummy session. Runbook snippet: ```aws ssm start-session --target i-0abcde12345 --document-name AWS-StartInteractiveCommand``` check s3 path sessions/{instance}/{ts}.
terry: for API bodies propose a security-only bucket s3://redwood-sec-archive/pt-bodies/ with KMS encryption and 90d retention. We'll route flagged requests to that stream for investigations.
sec-bot: New ticket: PT-823-REMED (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PT-823-REMED) :page_with_curl:
jess: small policy diff we'll add to evidence: ```- "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/deploy-service"} + /* removed deploy-service principal */```
sam: evidence we should collect: CMK creation CloudTrail events, key policy before/after, SSM transcript object keys (sample redacted transcript), API body object metadata (SHA256, uploader). Put all into s3://redwood-pt/evidence/PT-823/ with internal ACL.
sec-bot: Evidence folder created: s3://redwood-pt/evidence/PT-823/ (access: eng-security only)
jess: terraform note: I'll create new `aws_kms_key` and alias, then run `terraform apply` for backend update. If backend migration fails, rollback plan is to re-point alias and alert.
terry: retest ask to vendor: 1) attempt previously observed escalation path in staging (timeboxed) 2) confirm SSM transcripts include start/end and command transcript 3) validate API body archive contains request bodies for flagged runs and no tampering repro. Propose retest tomorrow 09:00-11:00 UTC.
pagerduty: I've opened a temporary on-call rota for the window.
jess: I'll drop the exact terraform + aws commands in the ticket runbook before the window.
sam: I'll run the dummy session once SSM config flips and paste S3 keys here.
terry: if anything goes wrong during rotation we abort and run the rollback alias script. Keep status pings short in this thread during the operation. :thumbsup:
